subject: Re: [NLW English] Great House Farm, Llandough | Cardiff Castle Furniture
source: Original email in the family's Gmail (read-only export); contact details redacted.
text:
Dear Dr Roberts,

Thank you for your response and for confirming the internal review outcome.

I acknowledge the clarification provided regarding the searches undertaken,
including reference to the Bute Estate series D153, D205 and D219, and the
application of section 21 in relation to publicly accessible catalogue
material.

However, I would like to clarify one remaining point for the record.

My concern throughout this request has not been whether the Library holds
physical furniture or objects as collection items. My request was
specifically for recorded information relating to furniture, furnishings,
fixtures, household effects and movable property connected with Great House
Farm (Ty Mawr), Llandough.

The questions I sought answers to were therefore about the existence of
records such as inventories, valuations, estate correspondence, fixture
records, transfers, disposals, provenance information and references within
relevant archival collections.

To avoid any misunderstanding, could you please confirm specifically:

   1. Whether the Bute Estate series D153, D205 and D219 were searched only
   for references to the property name (for example "Ty Mawr", "Great House
   Farm" or "Llandough"), or whether searches were also undertaken for related
   terms such as:


   - inventory;
   - valuation;
   - contents;
   - furniture;
   - furnishings;
   - fixtures;
   - household effects;
   - sale;
   - transfer;
   - disposal.


   2.

   Whether any archival collections other than the identified Bute Estate
   series were considered relevant and searched.
   3.

   Whether the Library holds, or has confirmed it does not hold, any:


   - household inventories;
   - estate valuations;
   - tenant records;
   - correspondence regarding contents or fixtures;
   - records of removal, disposal or transfer of items;
   - photographs or descriptions of household contents connected with Ty
   Mawr/Llandough.


   4. If no such records were identified, please confirm that this
   conclusion is based on searches undertaken across the relevant archival
   collections, rather than solely on the absence of catalogue descriptions
   containing the property name.

I appreciate that archival catalogues do not always describe individual
items or subjects in detail. However, the purpose of this clarification is
to establish precisely what searches were undertaken and what records were
considered, so that there is a clear and accurate record of the Library’s
position.

I am grateful for the assistance provided so far and would appreciate a
specific response to each point above.

Kind regards,

Requester

> Ms Daniel,
>
> Further to my internal review request, I would like to provide a short
> clarification regarding the scope of my original FOI request.
>
> Having reviewed my original request submitted on 3 July 2026, I wish to
> emphasise that the request was expressly for recorded information, not
> merely for physical objects held within NLW collections.
>
> The original request specifically sought:
> inventories, catalogues and asset registers;
> acquisition, disposal, loan and transfer records;
> provenance files and ownership records;
> photographs;
> correspondence concerning identification, recovery, ownership or location;
> internal reports, legal advice and memoranda;
> correspondence involving the Buckler or Williams families;
> correspondence with Bute Estate, Cardiff Castle, museums and other public
> bodies.
>
> Therefore, my concern is not that NLW does not hold furniture as part of a
> collection. I understand that point. My concern is whether relevant
> documentary records were searched across appropriate archival collections
> where references to such items may exist.
>
> For example, where NLW holds Bute Estate material relating to Ty
> Mawr/Llandough, I would appreciate confirmation as to whether those
> collections were searched for incidental references to:
> household inventories;
> fixtures;
> valuations;
> estate correspondence;
> transfers or disposals;
> provenance information;
> references to occupants or contents of the farmhouse.
>
> This clarification is provided to assist the internal review and ensure the
> original request is considered in its full context.
> I appreciate the catalogue references already provided and look forward to
> confirmation of the searches undertaken.
> ------------------------------

> Requester
>
> Jul 20 2026, 08:35PM via Email
> Ms Daniel,
>
> Thank you for your response dated 20 July 2026 regarding FOI/2026/09 and
> for identifying the catalogue references relating to Ty Mawr/Llandough
> within the Bute Estate collections.
>
> I would like to request an internal review, as I believe the response may
> have interpreted the scope of my request too narrowly.
>
> My request was for:
>
> "All recorded information held concerning furniture, furnishings, antiques,
> fixtures, heirlooms and other movable property originating from Great House
> Farm (Ty Mawr), Llandough, including any and all items received from Bute
> Estate, Cardiff Castle, Cardiff Council."
>
> I appreciate that the National Library of Wales does not collect furniture
> as a category of object and therefore may not hold the physical items
> themselves. However, my request was not limited to physical objects or
> acquisition files. It sought *all recorded information* relating to such
> items.
>
> This could include, for example:
>
> - inventories;
> - valuations;
> - estate correspondence;
> - fixture schedules;
> - probate references;
> - sale catalogues;
> - photographs;
> - tenancy records;
> - references within Bute Estate papers;
> - records of transfer, removal or disposal.
>
> The response confirms that NLW holds significant Bute Estate material
> relating to Ty Mawr, including maps, leases and deeds. However, it does not
> clarify whether those wider collections were searched for references to the
> farmhouse contents, fixtures, or related estate administration records.
>
> Could the internal review please clarify:
>
> 1.
>
> What collections and record series were searched in responding to this
> request?
> 2.
>
> Were searches undertaken beyond acquisition files, including within Bute
> Estate papers and related archival collections?
> 3.
>
> Were terms such as:
>
>
> - Great House Farm;
> - Ty Mawr;
> - Llandough;
> - fixtures;
> - inventory;
> - valuation;
> - contents;
> - furnishings;
> - sale;
> - transfer;
>
> used as part of the search?
>
> 4. If no relevant records are held, could you please confirm the
> searches undertaken and the basis for that conclusion?
>
> The reason this distinction matters is that my wider research concerns the
> documentary history of the farmhouse and garden plot following changes
> affecting Ty Mawr/Llandough after the 19th century. Records relating to
> fixtures, valuations, inventories or estate administration may provide
> important historical context, regardless of whether the physical items
> themselves remain.
>
> I am not asking NLW to determine ownership or provide a legal opinion. I am
> seeking confirmation that all relevant archival holdings have been
> considered and that the request has been searched against the appropriate
> collections.
>
> Thank you for your assistance. I look forward to the outcome of the
> internal review.
> ------------------------------

> Great House Farm, Llandough | Cardiff Castle Furniture
>
> *Freedom of Information Act 2000 Request*
>
> Sir/Madam,
>
> I am making this request under the Freedom of Information Act 2000.
>
> I seek all recorded information held concerning furniture, furnishings,
> antiques, fixtures, heirlooms and other movable property originating from *Great
> House Farm (Ty Mawr), Llandough*, including any and all items we received
> from *Bute Estate*, *Cardiff Castle*, *Cardiff Council. * Weather it be
> museums, archives or any other public body. I know museums have artifacts
> from our land in Llandough.
>
> Specifically, I request copies of all:
>
>    1. Inventories, catalogues and asset registers.
>    2. Acquisition, disposal, loan and transfer records.
>    3. Provenance files and ownership records.
>    4. Photographs of items identified as originating from Great House
>    Farm.
>    5. Correspondence concerning the identification, recovery, ownership
>    or location of such items.
>    6. Internal reports, legal advice and memoranda relating to Great
>    House Farm furniture or household effects.
>    7. Correspondence mentioning the Buckler or Williams families in
>    connection with these items.
>    8. Records concerning any efforts by Cardiff Council or Cardiff Castle
>    to trace, recover or secure items believed to have originated from Great
>    House Farm.
>    9. Correspondence with the Bute Estate, museums, the Department for
>    Culture, Media and Sport, the Reviewing Committee on the Export of Works of
>    Art and Objects of Cultural Interest (RCEWA), Arts Council England or any
>    other public authority regarding objects from Great House Farm.
>
> For context, I am allegeing that my family was unlawfully dispossessed of
> Great House Farm through fraud, and that furniture and other historic
> possessions belonging to the family were consequently dispersed. It's
> possible the bailiffs from BP were also SAS soldiers. We are still
> gathering actionable intelligence.
>
> I appreciate that the Freedom of Information Act does not require the
> authority to determine the merits of that allegation. However, it is
> directly relevant to understanding why I seek the recorded information.
>
> I am currently developing a full-scale replica of Great House Farm in
> Patagonia, Argentina as a museum dedicated to preserving the history of the
> house, its occupants and its contents. Should records identify surviving
> items from the farm, whether held by Cardiff Council, Cardiff Castle,
> museums or other public institutions, I intend to pursue their lawful
> return or transfer so they may ultimately be reunited with the
> reconstructed Great House Farm museum. This statement is provided solely as
> context for my request and does not seek a determination under the Freedom
> of Information Act.
>
> If any information is withheld, please identify each exemption relied upon
> and explain why it applies, including the outcome of any public interest
> test where required.
>
> If another public authority is more likely to hold the requested
> information, I would be grateful if you would transfer the request or
> advise me accordingly.
>
> I look forward to your response within the statutory time limit.
>
> Yours faithfully,
>
> Requester
